dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.text: 어서 오세요! 특별히 찾으시는 게 있어요?
dialogue.en: Hello! Are you looking for something special?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 재킷을 찾고 있어요. 중간 사이즈를 입어 봐도 돼요?
dialogue.en: I am looking for a jacket. Can I try on a medium size?

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: Of course. The fitting room is at the back.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 조금 너무 커요. 더 작은 사이즈나 더 싼 것이 있어요?
dialogue.en: It is a little too big. Do you have a smaller size, or something cheaper?

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.text: 여기 작은 사이즈가 있어요. 이번 주에 세일이라서 더 싸요.
dialogue.en: Here is a small one. It is on sale this week, so it is cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Perfect, I will take it. Where can I pay?
